chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Abd Allah ibn Muhammad al-Hajjal, from Tha'labah ibn Maymun, from Ma'mar ibn Yahya, who said:
I heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saying: The time of the ʿasr prayer is until sunset.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar; the Imam speaking in this narration
key_terms.سَمِعْتُ: I heard; indicates direct transmission from the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.غُرُوبِ: setting; the disappearance of the sun below the horizon
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the prescribed time or appointed period for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: Until when does the time of ʿasr prayer last according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the time for the ʿasr prayer continues until sunset. It is a concise fiqh report concerning the prescribed time of salat.
